global.title: Ontario airport set to spend $5.5 million on electric ground support equipment
global.summary: California’s Ontario International Airport (ONT) has been awarded a $~4.15 million grant from the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to expand its zero emission infrastructure and add more electric ground support equipment (GSE).

global.title: Port of Los Angeles commits $200 million to zero emission equipment
global.summary: The Port of Los Angeles has secured a new, 30-year lease with Yusen Terminals, with the marine terminal operator fully committed through 2056 in a deal that paves the way for an fresh, $200 million investment in zero-emission cargo-handling equipment. (!)

global.title: 130-ton electric trucks 4,000 feet beneath the surface of the Earth [video]
global.summary: Swedish mining company LKAB is putting a pair of massive, 130-ton GVW electric Scania haul trucks to work at its Malmberget iron ore mine – which happens to be more than 4,000 feet below the surface of the Earth.

global.title: Kia’s new EV3 is the same price as the Niro Hybrid, and nearly $10,000 less than the Niro EV
global.summary: The new Kia EV3 is essentially an upgraded version of the now-retired Niro EV, and it’s about $10,000 cheaper.

global.title: Santa Monica goes big on electric buses with 130 fast chargers
global.summary: Santa Monica, California’s public Big Blue Bus fleet is getting 130 DC fast-charging ports as it works toward building an entirely electric fleet by 2032.

global.title: BYD’s cheapest EV is about to get a ‘big’ sibling: Here’s what it looks like in person
global.summary: BYD is preparing to launch a new electric hatch, positioned between the Dolphin and Seagull (Dolphin Surf) in terms of size.

global.title: BYD installed 10,000 hyper-fast 1,500kW chargers in just 5 months
global.summary: BYD announced that it has already installed 10,000 of its 1.5 megawatt “flash charging” stations, despite only starting earlier this year. The number puts it halfway to its lofty goal of 20,000 stations by year’s end – and just about on pace to hit it.

global.title: Toyota launches its updated bZ5 electric SUV at half the price of a Tesla Model Y
global.summary: The bZ5 is about the size of a Tesla Model Y and much more high-tech than Toyota vehicles we are used to.

global.title: Tesla Full Self-Driving likes trains a bit too much
global.summary: A Tesla running the latest version of “Full Self-Driving” failed to stop at an active railroad crossing this week and nearly drove straight into a passing train, according to the driver and as evidenced in dashcam footage.
